description: Replace the stub LocalModelStore manifest writer with a real resumable Inkling 2 Mini GGUF download and LocalModelServer Metal GPU inference.

steps.send: Replace the stub `LocalModelStore` manifest writer in `apps/openagents-desktop/Window+Dialogs.swift` with a real resumable Hugging Face download of `Inkling-2-Mini-IQ4_NL.gguf` and add `LocalModelServer` to launch `llama-server` on demand. Wire `Window+Runs.swift`, `host.c`, `host.h`, `page/models.coax`, `page/host-api.coax`, and `page/checks/models-checks.coax` so Inkling 2 Mini turns run locally without requiring cloud credentials. Verify with `swiftc -parse apps/openagents-desktop/Window+Dialogs.swift apps/openagents-desktop/Window+Runs.swift && coax/bin/coax test apps/openagents-desktop/page.coax --library --only model`.

graders.run: grep -q LocalModelServer apps/openagents-desktop/Window+Dialogs.swift && swiftc -parse apps/openagents-desktop/Window+Dialogs.swift apps/openagents-desktop/Window+Runs.swift && coax/bin/coax test apps/openagents-desktop/page.coax --library --only model
